name: Republic of Maryland (1854–1857)
description: Eleven horizontal stripes alternating yellow and black, with a navy canton bearing a white cross.
history: Maryland in Africa, founded at Cape Palmas in 1834 by the Maryland State Colonization Society, declared itself the independent Republic of Maryland on 29 May 1854 and was annexed by Liberia in 1857 after the Grebo war. Its constitution described a flag of red and white stripes with a cross on a blue canton, but the flag is conventionally depicted, as here, in the black and gold of Maryland's Calvert arms; the discrepancy is unresolved.

features.symbolism: the black and gold of the Calvert arms of Maryland, the colony's American sponsor
